hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: A daemon-owned, self-describing settings contract feeds a native JetBrains Settings page that renders whatever the daemon reports. The daemon's single-definition catalog is enriched with two structured fields (allowed fixed values and a group label) and, together with the recognized role taxonomy and tier names, is exposed over ONE new read-only IPC. The plugin adds config gateway methods behind the established sealed three-state result pattern and a native applicationConfigurable that builds a grouped, collapsible Swing form purely from the daemon's description — hardcoding no setting, group, role, or tier. Reads use the new catalog IPC plus the existing value read; writes reuse the existing segment-aware write. The plugin owns no settings semantics; the daemon stays the single source of truth.

ownedContracts.name: Self-describing settings catalog (enriched ConfigOption + role taxonomy) over config.catalog, and its plugin read surface
ownedContracts.purpose: The single daemon-owned description the whole IDE surface renders from: every recognized setting with type/default/allowed-values/group/description, the recognized roles and their default tiers, the allowed tier names, and the current values — delivered over one read IPC and mirrored as plugin DTOs behind a sealed read result. Satisfies k1/k2/k3 and is the foundation every downstream Story renders from.

boundary.internal: The daemon-side enrichment mechanics stay private to s1: exactly how each of the 31 existing catalog entries is assigned its group and (for enum settings) its allowed-values list; how config.catalog assembles the payload (reading CONFIG_CATALOG, the role taxonomy, and current values); and how the contract test and boot reconcile are extended so the two new fields do not disturb defaults-on-boot or retired-path disjointness. None of these internals are consumed by other Stories — they consume only the payload shape (sc1).

adjacentBoundaries.internal: Private to s2: read-only rendering, collapsible groups, daemon-unavailable state.
Private to s3: per-type edit controls, validation, dirty/apply/reset, write-rejected surfacing.
Private to s4: per-role overrides sub-section (models.tasks.<roleId>).
Private to s5: per-repo overrides sub-section (models.byRepo.<repoPath>.*).

hldContextSlice.rolloutPhase: Phase A — Daemon settings contract (schema + catalog IPC)

nonFunctional.performance: The settings page loads from a single config.catalog round-trip plus the existing value read; no polling.
nonFunctional.security: No new surface beyond the existing local Unix-socket transport; secrets/keys out of scope; config.catalog is read-only.
nonFunctional.observability: config.catalog is a pure read; config.write already logs each write.
nonFunctional.durability: Persistence unchanged — the daemon's config.json write + reconcile own durability; config.catalog never writes.

api.name: ConfigOption
api.signature: interface ConfigOption { readonly path: string; readonly type: 'string'|'number'|'boolean'|'enum'; readonly default: unknown; readonly desc: string; readonly enumValues?: readonly string[]; readonly group: string }

returns.meaning: The enriched single-definition-site catalog row: existing path/type/default/desc plus a required group label and, for enum settings, the fixed allowed-values list. Non-enum rows omit enumValues.

preconditions: Defined only in src/config/config-catalog.ts (single definition site); src/cli/config-catalog.ts continues to only re-export it.
postconditions: Every one of the 31 CONFIG_CATALOG rows carries a non-empty group; every row with type:'enum' carries a non-empty enumValues; row count stays 31; RETIRED_PATHS unchanged (6, disjoint).

api.name: buildSettingsCatalog

parameters.name: rawConfig
parameters.purpose: The parsed config.json object (or {} when absent/unreadable) from which each catalog path's current value is resolved.

returns.meaning: options = CONFIG_CATALOG verbatim; groups = distinct group labels in catalog order; roles/tierNames from reasoningRoleTaxonomy(); values = per-catalog-path current value resolved from rawConfig (absent path omitted ⇒ unset/using-default).

errors.condition: Never throws; an empty rawConfig yields a complete schema with an empty values map.

preconditions: Pure: reads only its argument + the static CONFIG_CATALOG and reasoningRoleTaxonomy(); performs no IO and no write.
postconditions: options.length === 31; groups first-seen order; tierNames === rankOf keys; values has an entry only for paths present in rawConfig.

api.name: config.catalog

returns.meaning: New read-only IPC handler beside config.show: reads PATHS.config (parse-or-{}), calls buildSettingsCatalog, returns the payload. Read-only — never writes config.json, never reloads.

errors.condition: config.json missing/unparseable ⇒ returns the full schema with values={} (mirrors config.show returning {}).

preconditions: Registered in the same dispatch object as config.show/config.write; over the existing Unix-socket transport (k3).
postconditions: Returns the SettingsCatalogPayload; config.json unmodified; no reload.

dataModelChanges.details: Add `readonly group: string` (required) and `readonly enumValues?: readonly string[]` (optional; present iff type==='enum'). Backfill all 31 rows with a group label and enum rows with their allowed-values (lifted from desc). Additive — no existing field changes, no row added/removed.

New exported payload type in src/config/settings-catalog.ts: { options: readonly ConfigOption[]; groups: readonly string[]; roles: readonly {id:string; defaultTier:string}[]; tierNames: readonly string[]; values: Readonly<Record<string,unknown>> } — the sc1 wire shape config.catalog returns.

interactionWithShared.howDetails: S001 implements sc1's daemon side: enriched ConfigOption, SettingsCatalogPayload, the pure buildSettingsCatalog assembler, and the read-only config.catalog IPC. The plugin-side DTO/gateway mirror is the consumers' surface (first built by S002). All derived from the single catalog + reasoningRoleTaxonomy(), never duplicated (lc1/k1).

errorCases.scenario: config.json is missing or contains invalid JSON when config.catalog reads it.
errorCases.detection: readFileSync/JSON.parse wrapped in try/catch (mirroring config.show); throw caught, rawConfig defaults to {}.
errorCases.response: buildSettingsCatalog({}) returns the complete schema with values={}; no top-level RPC error.
errorCases.userImpact: IDE still gets the full description; everything shows unset/using-default. No failure surfaced.

errorCases.scenario: A catalog row backfilled with a missing/empty group (authoring error).
errorCases.detection: The extended contract test asserts every row has a non-empty group; a miss fails at test time.
errorCases.response: Test fails before ship; the row must be given a group.
errorCases.userImpact: Caught pre-release; otherwise the setting lands in an empty-named group.

errorCases.scenario: An enum row backfilled without enumValues, or enumValues on a non-enum row.
errorCases.detection: The extended contract test asserts every type:'enum' row has a non-empty enumValues (and non-enum rows omit it).
errorCases.response: Test fails before ship; the enum row must carry its allowed-values.
errorCases.userImpact: Caught pre-release; otherwise a fixed-choice setting has no choices for S003's chooser.

edgeCases.input: A catalog path unset in config.json (or an absent intermediate like models.tiers).
edgeCases.expected: Omitted from values (unset/using-default); no crash on the absent intermediate.

edgeCases.input: config.json contains non-catalog keys (models.tasks.<roleId>, models.byRepo.<repoPath>.*, stale keys).
edgeCases.expected: values is keyed only by catalog paths; non-catalog keys are not included (dynamic overrides are S004/S005's concern).

edgeCases.input: A catalog path whose current value equals its default.
edgeCases.expected: Still reported in values with its actual value; equals-default is not elided — the consumer decides how to show it.

invariantsToPreserve.text: config-catalog.ts remains the SINGLE definition site of CONFIG_CATALOG and ConfigOption; the CLI re-export stays reference-identical (FROM_CLI===FROM_CONFIG). Adding fields introduces no second definition.
CONFIG_CATALOG stays exactly 31 rows (contract test assert.equal(length,31)); the enrichment adds fields, never rows.
RETIRED_PATHS stays the 6 declared entries, disjoint from every live path; no path changes.
The boot reconcile still fills every default and prunes retired paths unchanged; the additive fields do not participate in fill/prune.
config.catalog is READ-ONLY: reads PATHS.config, never writes config.json or reloads.

testLevels.purpose: Preserve every existing catalog invariant and add the enrichment-completeness guards.
subjects: single definition site + FROM_CLI===FROM_CONFIG + no src/cli import
NEW: every row has a non-empty group
NEW: every enum row has a non-empty enumValues; non-enum rows omit it

current values resolved from a fixture; unset path / absent intermediate omitted

non-catalog keys never appear in values

subjects: handler returns a SettingsCatalogPayload (options 31, groups/roles/tierNames present)
missing/invalid config.json ⇒ full schema with values={}, no top-level error

provingTests: unit: buildSettingsCatalog({}) returns all 31 options with path/type/default/desc/group + enum enumValues, plus groups/roles/tierNames
contract: every row has a group; every enum row has enumValues
integration: config.catalog returns the full options payload
unit: values resolved from a fixture; set paths present, unset/absent omitted

contract: length===31, RETIRED_PATHS 6 disjoint, single-site + FROM_CLI===FROM_CONFIG hold

testStrategy.testFramework: node:test + node:assert/strict, run via `npx tsx --test` (the src/config/__tests__ convention)

migration.stateBefore: ConfigOption has four fields (path/type/default/desc); 31-row CONFIG_CATALOG; enum allowed-values only in prose desc; no group. Daemon has config.show + config.write but NO config.catalog. Contract test asserts length===31, single-site, FROM_CLI===FROM_CONFIG, RETIRED_PATHS 6 disjoint.
migration.stateAfter: ConfigOption has group (required) + enumValues (optional, enum rows), all 31 rows backfilled, row count + invariants unchanged. New pure buildSettingsCatalog + read-only config.catalog IPC. config.show/config.write/reconcile unchanged.

migrationSteps.action: Add the two additive fields to ConfigOption: required group:string and optional enumValues?:readonly string[].
Backfill all 31 rows with a group label and enum rows with allowed-values from desc. No rows added/removed; paths unchanged.
Extend the contract test with the group + enumValues completeness assertions alongside the untouched existing invariants.
Register the read-only config.catalog handler in src/daemon/index.ts beside config.show (read parse-or-{}, assemble, return; no write, no reload).

migration.backwardCompat: The four existing ConfigOption fields are unchanged; the two new fields are additive (group populated everywhere, enumValues optional). All existing consumers (reconcile, CLI re-export, contract test) keep working; config.show/config.write untouched; config.json neither read-migrated nor rewritten. Only config.catalog is added — no method removed or renamed.

alternativesConsidered.name: Inline enumValues+group on ConfigOption + a pure catalog assembler
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add readonly enumValues?/group directly to ConfigOption, backfill the 31 rows inline, and add one pure buildSettingsCatalog() that config.catalog wraps.
alternativesConsidered.approach: ConfigOption gains enumValues?/group; all 31 rows backfilled in place so the single catalog literal stays the one definition site. A pure buildSettingsCatalog(rawConfig) assembles options/groups/roles/tierNames/values; the config.catalog handler is a thin reader beside config.show that never throws. The contract test gains group + enumValues completeness assertions.
pros: Keeps the single definition site (lc1/k1) — metadata lives on the row.
Pure assembler is unit-testable off a fixture.
config.catalog stays a trivial read-only reader; honours k3.
Additive to the type — reconcile/defaults untouched; length=31 stays green.
cons: enumValues must be authored to match the desc (a mismatch is a data error, caught by the presence test but not for semantic correctness).

alternativesConsidered.name: Sidecar metadata table keyed by path
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Leave ConfigOption as-is and add a second const mapping each path to its {group, enumValues}, merged in when config.catalog assembles the payload.
alternativesConsidered.approach: A new SETTINGS_METADATA: Record<string,{group,enumValues?}> is joined with CONFIG_CATALOG by path in buildSettingsCatalog; ConfigOption is unchanged.
cons: Re-introduces a SECOND path-keyed definition that must track CONFIG_CATALOG — the drift k1/lc1 forbid.
Needs its own completeness guard; a path typo is a silent mismatch, not a compile error.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Functionally equivalent payload but forks the schema into a path-keyed sidecar (violates k1/lc1), trading the whole point of the enrichment for leaving the type shape untouched.

alternativesConsidered.name: Derive enumValues + group at read time from the desc/path
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add no stored fields; parse allowed values from each enum's desc and infer group from the path prefix in buildSettingsCatalog.
alternativesConsidered.approach: buildSettingsCatalog regex-extracts quoted tokens from an enum's desc for enumValues and infers group from the path's leading segment(s). No change to ConfigOption or the rows.
pros: Zero change to the rows or the type.
No new stored data to sync.
cons: Allowed values become a brittle parse of prose — a reworded desc silently changes/empties them (fails ac1's structured requirement).
Path-prefix grouping is a heuristic, not the intended human grouping.
Re-creates the derive-from-prose/hardcode-and-drift failure the Epic removes.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Cheapest but re-creates the derive-from-prose brittleness the Epic exists to remove; fails ac1's structured-allowed-values requirement and cannot express intended grouping.

citations.quotedText: interface ConfigOption { path/type/default/desc } + const CONFIG_CATALOG (31 rows), single definition site; enum allowed-values only in desc; no group/enumValues; RETIRED_PATHS = 6.
config.show reads PATHS.config parse-or-{}; config.write segment-aware + reloadChatConfig; no config.catalog handler.
reasoningRoleTaxonomy(): RoleTaxonomy { roles: RoleDescriptor{id,criticality,defaultTier}[]; rankOf }; tier names = rankOf keys cheap|mid|core.
asserts CONFIG_CATALOG.length===31, single definition site, FROM_CLI===FROM_CONFIG, RETIRED_PATHS 6 disjoint entries.
boot reconcile reads the catalog to fill defaults + prune retired paths.
